about.title: About | USAvionix
about.html:
About

Advancing autonomy to protect nations, strengthen resilience, and shape the future of defense and critical infrastructure.

The future of defense, emergency response, and infrastructure security will depend on autonomous systems capable of seeing, deciding, and acting faster than emerging threats.


USAvionix is building that future with dual-use autonomous platforms engineered for both military and critical civilian missions.

The Economics

Covering large areas and long distances with aircraft, crews, and patrols scales with every square mile. Intelligent autonomous coverage doesn't. The cost gap widens every year.

The Inflection

Onboard compute can now run serious models in the air. Intelligence no longer has to live in a command center on the other end of a link.

The Flywheel

Every flight feeds Athena, our intelligence foundation. The system gets smarter with every deployment, and that advantage compounds.

© USAvionix Inc. 2026

athena.title: Athena | USAvionix
athena.html:
Athena

The intelligence and data foundation of USAvionix, built to understand the environment, extract meaning, and continuously learn.

Athena is not a single model. It is a collection of models, data systems, and learning processes that work together to interpret the world and continuously improve, determining what something is and what it means in context.

Perception & Reasoning

Vision and language models detect, track, and interpret intent, risk, and behavior with context.

Structured Intelligence

Normalizes raw sensor data into detections, tracks, and inferred events for real-time use by Phalanx.

Continuous Learning

The platform's long-term memory. Data from every flight flows back to refine and retrain the models, an advantage that compounds with every deployment.

Ready to talk to us?

© USAvionix Inc. 2026

delta.title: Delta | USAvionix
delta.html:
Delta

A subsonic, jet-powered ISR drone built for speed, autonomy, and real-time intelligence over ranges of 300 to 500+ kilometers.

Reaching speeds up to 500 km/h, it launches on its own, lands vertically, and operates solo or as part of an autonomous fleet, delivering persistent, high-altitude surveillance at scale.

Autonomy

End-to-end autonomous operation with vertical takeoff and landing.

Adaptive Intelligence

Phalanx AI updates mission logic in real time and shares insights across the fleet.

Operational Resilience

Mesh networking + satellite uplink maintain coordination in denied environments.

Ready to talk to us?

© USAvionix Inc. 2026

partners.title: Partner Program | USAvionix
partners.html:
For Large-Area Operators

Partner Program

Securing a large area is a problem of speed over distance. Helicopters don't scale. Patrols are slow. Fixed cameras watch one location. Short-range drones can't cover it. We are building a system to search entire regions and return a clear picture faster than any of them.

When Conventional Coverage Breaks Down

Our partners share the same operational reality:

  • Areas too large to watch continuously.
  • Response times stretched thin by distance.
  • No shared, real-time picture across teams.
  • Threats faster than the response.
  • Coverage that scales only with more crews.
  • Ready to test and iterate alongside us.

Where It Works

Every one of these is a distance problem first. One platform covers all of them.

Long-Range Response

Persistent Surveillance

Border Operations

Maritime Security

Critical Infrastructure

Search & Rescue

Wildfire Detection

Military ISR

We're taking a handful of founding partners. Each deployment is hands-on.

© USAvionix Inc. 2026

phalanx.title: Phalanx AI | USAvionix
phalanx.html:
Phalanx AI

The AI command layer that unifies sensor data, coordinates autonomous fleets, and turns real-time intelligence into action.

Phalanx AI delivers real-time mission intelligence and coordination. Powered by SARA, operators speak intent while the system adapts, routes, and integrates across connected platforms.

Unified Intelligence

Merges sensor data, maps, and external signals into one real-time operational picture.

Autonomous Command

Directs single units or large swarms with adaptive, real-time decision-making.

Seamless Integration

Works across existing systems via extensible SDKs and APIs.

Ready to talk to us?

© USAvionix Inc. 2026

sara.title: SARA | USAvionix
sara.html:
SARA

Strategic Autonomous Recon Agent: natural-language mission control that converts plain-English commands into real-time autonomous execution.

SARA converts spoken instructions into mission logic, optimizing routes, coordinating fleets, and adapting as conditions change.

Natural Commands

State objectives in plain English; SARA converts them into mission logic instantly.

Contextual Reasoning

Understands environment, intent, and constraints to make informed decisions.

Adaptive Execution

Adjusts routing, sensing, and priorities dynamically as situations evolve.
